proposals.lesson: When the owner designates an existing real-workload baseline, lock the exact artifact hashes and run only new candidates. Preserve runtime differences as an explicit caveat; do not silently relabel the old configuration.
proposals.evidence: quick32-v3 completed 32/32 natural-stop requests with zero errors at concurrency 1, 5, 8 and 16

proposals.lesson: One variable is an attribution step, not a final-stack constraint. Measure a treatment alone, retain it only after correctness and performance gates, add it to the current best stack, and keep ablations while comparing every stack with the same original.
proposals.evidence: FlashComm1, BF16 FRACTAL_NZ and their non-quantized cumulative launcher/config are isolated

proposals.lesson: Natural EOS includes empty-text EOS-only completions; benchmark TTFT from the first token event. Reject an optimization even when transport succeeds if response hashes diverge.
proposals.evidence: The harness correction recovered four valid EOS-only requests; Qwen3.5 MTP was rejected with 16-21 response mismatches and latency regressions

proposals.lesson: A documented dense communication optimization is not stack-eligible until the target architecture survives graph construction. On Qwen3.5 TP4, FlashComm1 activated sequence parallelism and normalized graph sizes, but the GDN graph retained an unsplit symbolic sequence length and failed before readiness. Classify this as an implementation/runtime failure, not a performance regression or rejection of the general method.
proposals.evidence: Run flashcomm1-fixedorig-npu4-7-20260904T1816Z; service.log SHA256 35ef543dd9ab29d127ce01b2556b6abf8b0a46e9068320f7a97d4e69cf59e692; operation exec-000000000000053a exited 70 before any benchmark cell

proposals.lesson: Static support for BF16 FRACTAL_NZ and MatMulAllReduce does not imply composability. On this v0.23.0 path, NZ weight transformation succeeded, but aclnnMatmulAllReduce required x2 in ND and failed before readiness. Record this as an interaction failure and test NZ with the fixed original's MatMulAllReduce-disabled setting before rejecting the layout itself.
proposals.evidence: Run bf16-nz-fixedorig-npu4-7-20260904T1838Z; service.log SHA256 0756f2a7770166afa54d4e4ff08178be13d6b81287a28fa861ec9e1b3ddf82b9; operation exec-000000000000056e exited 70

proposals.lesson: A treatment can deliver a real median win in part of the matrix and still be rejected. BF16 FRACTAL_NZ with MatMulAllReduce disabled roughly halved c1/c5 TTFT, but it changed exact outputs, missed the TPOT target, and regressed c16 TTFT. Preserve the useful locality signal without promoting the treatment to the cumulative stack.
proposals.evidence: Run bf16-nz-mmar-off-fixedorig-npu4-7-20260904T1845Z; decision SHA256 323ee9620294fba17bfd678e30bab5012512e211c9016303e9c8ef0ddb2b791a

proposals.lesson: When a nominally semantics-preserving communication switch changes exact response hashes and produces a large TTFT shift across a different physical device set, do not credit the whole delta to the switch. Keep the owner-designated original immutable, but run a no-op control candidate on the assigned devices to quantify run/device drift before accepting correctness criteria or performance attribution.
proposals.evidence: MMAR-only run mmar-on-fixedorig-npu4-7-20260904T1921Z completed all cells but mismatched 17/20/17/15 response hashes; decision SHA256 870c8f04911b838670d4e0414b3846d14fa7cb2cb0774b15230a573f681ecc0b

proposals.lesson: If a no-op control with the same model, seed and runtime switches changes many output hashes, exact equality to a historical run is not a calibrated semantic correctness gate. Keep the hashes as a diagnostic, fail closed, and add privacy-safe aggregate comparison to labeled references before accepting a treatment.
proposals.evidence: Control run control-mmar-off-fixedorig-npu4-7-20260904T1943Z differed from the original in 15/15/19/16 hashes; control decision SHA256 ff77a6fc8aadbf6d0561834b9f42a12a562cee76f5da4c4a6f9ae68eaf803b39

proposals.lesson: Continue reporting every candidate against the owner-designated fixed denominator, but also use a same-device no-op control for causal attribution. In this run the fixed-original comparison suggested large MMAR gains, while the same-device control reduced net TPOT gain to 0-5.3% and c1-c8 TTFT gain to 2.4-8.6%.
proposals.evidence: MMAR run mmar-on-fixedorig-npu4-7-20260904T1921Z versus control run control-mmar-off-fixedorig-npu4-7-20260904T1943Z

proposals.lesson: On vLLM 0.23.0 multiprocess TP, disabling async scheduling is not sufficient to make torch_npu profiling safe. The worker profiler is lazily constructed through a profile RPC thread, while CANN requires external profiler initialization on the registerClient thread. Preserve the failure and switch the collection mechanism rather than weakening inference semantics.
proposals.evidence: Run fixed-runtime-mmar-off-npu4-7-20260904T2004Z; operation exec-0000000000000659; /stop_profile returned 500 after TP0 exited and the executor was canceled

proposals.lesson: For a long-lived Ascend inference service whose framework profiler lifecycle is broken, set PROFILING_MODE=dynamic before startup and use msprof attach to bracket a real request. In TP workloads collect one worker/device at a time, keep the profile diagnostic-only, and export op_summary for hotspot ranking.
proposals.evidence: NPU4 smoke operation exec-000000000000066f completed start/stop/quit and export; one op_summary contained 41119 operator calls

proposals.lesson: Rank hotspot totals by request phase before choosing an optimization. Dynamic attach captured one 173830us AllReduce before the detected prefill window, while steady AllReduce p50/p95 were only 22.86/23.70us. The outlier is evidence of startup or synchronization cost, not a representative collective kernel latency.
proposals.evidence: Full-model run fixed-runtime-msprof-tp0-npu4-7-20260904T2043Z; op_summary SHA256 3350ab8564e00f3cb1f549823445d411efa0dddc52f7c6739c961f68a0cb4d5f

proposals.lesson: When dense decode is dominated by low-batch GEMMs, test training-free verified multi-token execution before rewriting a low-share state-space operator. On vLLM-Ascend use the NPU ngram proposer when async scheduling is frozen; the CPU ngram proposer is incompatible with async scheduling.
proposals.evidence: Post-prefill rank-0 window: MatMulV2 70.702%, AllReduce 10.530%, recurrent GDN 2.406%; exact image dispatches ngram_gpu to npu_ngram_spec_decode

proposals.lesson: Use per-position acceptance counters to decide whether speculative retuning is economically possible. If first-position acceptance is already far below the break-even cost of one extra verified token, reducing k cannot rescue the method and another full matrix would waste accelerator time.
proposals.evidence: ngram-gpu run accepted only 14.809% of first positions and 6.934% of all draft tokens; c1 TPOT was 4.82x slower

proposals.lesson: Treat a concurrency stall as a runtime rejection, not a long-tail latency sample. Capture engine counters, request state and logs before stopping the exact candidate container, preserve partial completed requests as observed-only evidence, and do not run higher-concurrency cells after the engine stops making progress.
proposals.evidence: At c5 the ngram_gpu engine froze after 25/32 completions with four Running requests and repeated Poller timed out messages for more than three minutes; no OOM occurred

proposals.lesson: A failed benchmark matrix must still close with a machine-readable terminal decision and checksums. The runner must preserve the workload exit status, finalize logs and metrics, classify missing cells as not-run, and produce reject-runtime-failure rather than leaving an ambiguous artifact directory.
proposals.evidence: Failure-finalizer tests cover a 25/32 c5 cell plus absent c8/c16 cells and require analyzer exit 4 with decision reject-runtime-failure

proposals.lesson: When current operator documentation and framework policy disagree, benchmark the exact model shapes on the target topology before changing the serving path. A documented incremental-scenario boundary did not make separate MatMul plus AllReduce competitive for Qwen3.5 TP4 decode.
proposals.evidence: NPU4-7 BF16 microbenchmark across two real projection shapes and nine decode M values measured separate/fused geometric speedup 0.469982; SHA256SUMS 2c5d82d989d963ad3f55b1bcbc15d94445d8fc36c06f459bf5e576afc714933a

proposals.lesson: For Qwen3.5 hybrid attention/GDN, a projection-local FlashComm path must flatten its send buffer, derive padding from the selected projection's local row count, keep the pad operation symbolic and unconditional through torch.compile, slice back to the unpadded row count, and restore arbitrary leading dimensions. Global token padding, exclude-by-name, or a Python conditional each leave a graph-capture failure.
proposals.evidence: dc48edac fixed all-to-all buffer rank, 5b334581 exposed compile specialization, and 65f780ee passed health plus every FULL capture size on NPU4-7; official-image focused tests passed 7/7

proposals.lesson: Treat communication-feature startup and E2E promotion as separate gates. FlashComm2 OProj1 can be made graph-safe on this stack and still lose to retained fused MMAR in every concurrency cell; successful capture is implementation evidence, not a performance claim.
proposals.evidence: flashcomm2-symbolicpad-oproj1-mmar-prefetch-0p1-20260905T043000Z completed 128/128 requests, but regressed retained TTFT by 5.21-9.33% and TPOT by 4.58-8.16%; SHA256SUMS digest 32d5a4d30844da7172d9d9d202c89b8f8f2f25df2271fbd36d978f4c7ca9bf18

proposals.lesson: Do not transfer a larger HCCL buffer recommendation from multi-node or different-hardware examples without a full workload matrix. On single-node 910B4 TP4, 1024 MB helped c16 but regressed at least one retained metric at c1, c5 and c8, so the all-cell stack stays at 512 MB.
proposals.evidence: Run mmar-prefetch-0p1-hccl-buff1024-20260905T031500Z completed 128 natural-stop requests; incremental decision SHA256 bd362658448226471d1a4ac11a386d621a7db02c51263c15871582c7d59686f5

proposals.lesson: After parameter, topology, compiler, speculative and projection-communication routes are exhausted, stop scanning low-leverage switches. Preserve the best stack and hand off the measured structural prerequisite: reduce or overlap the roughly 128 serialized row-parallel collective paths per decode step while preserving the model and 133K serving contract.
proposals.evidence: Retained TPOT gains plateau at 1.334x-1.556x while the MMAR profile attributes 48.214% to its AICPU control kernel and counts 13696 calls over 107 decode steps

proposals.lesson: For BF16 communication-fusion correctness, use model-like operand scales before interpreting absolute error. Standard-deviation-1 values on both sides of a wide matmul amplify accumulation-order differences; preserve that run as diagnostic and require a correctly scaled rerun before E2E promotion.
proposals.evidence: The first MMAR+Add+RMSNorm run measured 1.833736x geometric speedup but failed add_out checks with std=1 operands while normalized output max_abs stayed <=0.046875; upstream samples use std=0.1.

proposals.lesson: An idle npu-smi process table is not sufficient for safe allocation while another container is starting. Check running containers' HostConfig device reservations first, then check npu-smi, and fail closed without stopping an unowned container.
proposals.evidence: p0_aff reserved /dev/davinci4..7 while npu-smi briefly showed no process; two later task starts failed aclInit with Resource_Busy before measurement.

proposals.lesson: Long-lived monitor/admin containers may mount all device files without owning an NPU runtime. Allow only exact operator-verified container names through the reservation layer, then retain the npu-smi process gate; never use a broad device-mount exception.
proposals.evidence: The two allowed containers had run for 13 hours and 11 days with only sleep/idle shell processes, while a newly created p0_ck workload was still rejected with exit 48.

proposals.lesson: Promote a communication-tail fusion to model integration only after every profiled projection shape and captured decode batch size passes both output checks and no latency cell regresses. A favorable average cannot waive a single incorrect or slower cell.
proposals.evidence: Corrected TP4 BF16 MMAR+Add+RMSNorm run passed all 18 cells, delivered 1.851721x geometric-mean speedup and a 1.706554x minimum, with immutable result SHA256 0dfe46d44c907e513e8fa2a0a6bc48e2c26c39fc981bfe30cc5f2fa29cb2d8ac.

proposals.lesson: Trigger: a custom graph pass compiles and the service becomes ready. Action: before accepting any E2E latency, require pass configuration, registration, range applicability, positive match count and generated-graph fused-op evidence; API availability or a clean compile is insufficient. Destination: future update to the Ascend benchmark-evidence skill's runtime activation gate.
proposals.evidence: Verification: two ready/compiled attempts retained 0 fused ops because kwargs and dispatcher targets did not match; after both fixes and the enable_npugraph_ex pass-manager correction, every TP rank reported 64 fused patterns and integration-check SHA256 a00c7be3c48fe823fb7c49455394e2dbe07cb0a09f934f9f171738f441a1716a.

proposals.lesson: Trigger: a graph fusion is active but whole-model latency gains are smaller than its isolated microbenchmark. Action: use a real-request profile to count fused and unfused kernels, then inspect the saved graph shape for the missing path; keep summed kernel durations diagnostic-only. Destination: future update to the Ascend benchmark-evidence skill's profiling section.
proposals.evidence: Verification: fused-tail msprof recorded 6720 fused MMAR+Add+RMS calls but also 6976 unfused MMAR and 6976 AddRmsNormBias calls; graph inspection traced the remaining attention tails through a full-tensor preallocation copy, leading to source 081953bd.

proposals.lesson: Trigger: validate a source-only Python patch against an installed release image whose repository dependencies may not match the checkout. Action: overlay only the changed package module and focused test, not the entire source tree, while keeping the released binary extension fixed. Destination: host-development tool-adapter note for release-image source validation.
proposals.evidence: Verification: mounting the whole checkout exposed unrelated npugraph/torchair dependency skew; the minimal module overlay in the official vLLM-Ascend 0.23.0 image passed all 3 focused normalization tests in 16.05 seconds.

proposals.lesson: Trigger: a graph helper passes direct torch.fx.Graph unit tests but fails only inside the compiler pass manager. Action: inspect the actual manager/backend call boundary, support the concrete GraphModule contract explicitly, and add a regression test using that exact object type before another accelerator run. Destination: future update to the Ascend graph-fusion validation checklist.
proposals.evidence: Verification: operation exec-0000000000000c25 failed before readiness because npugraph_ex passed a GraphModule named <lambda> and the helper accessed .nodes directly; source c5496ef7 uses GraphModule.graph and the official 0.23.0 image passed 4/4 focused tests including the new contract case.

proposals.lesson: Trigger: a mutation-normalization pass accepts the correct GraphModule object but still reports zero rewrites in the live backend. Action: reproduce the source assignment through both Dynamo and torch.export, test the post-export aten topology used by the backend, and retain shape and consumer guards before another accelerator run. Destination: future update to the Ascend graph-fusion validation checklist.
proposals.evidence: Verification: v8 compiled without the prior GraphModule exception but all ranks reported Normalized 0/Fused 64. In the official 0.23.0 image, output[:n]=value changed from operator.setitem in Dynamo to aten.slice.Tensor plus aten.copy_.default after export. Source 573ea294 covers both exported copy forms, rejects partial slices and passes 7/7 focused tests.
